M-KERNEL-INTROSPECTION.Summary: Gives agents and tools one Effect service that resolves Loci, describes, verifies, impacts and invokes through the kernel with typed failures for unknown ids and capabilities.

M-KERNEL-IMPACT.Summary: Derives the change impact of a Locus or capability from the model and compares two models into the changes a reviewer must read.

M-KERNEL-API.Summary: Is the public entry of the kernel and re-exports exactly the names of the kernel contract, never the Bun-only closure module.
